scope: Read-only supplied patch, not validation. Findings addressed in ledger_v1 before actual tests; later v2 eligibility correction separately recorded. Both attempts rejected.

disposition.1_existing_rule: Not applicable: IntegrationColumns3D declares its empty local rule immediately on entry and does not append until completion. No inherited quadrature exists.
disposition.2_nonfinite_heap: Validate positive finite radial values/errors before inserting heap keys, positive finite weights, and finite aggregate estimates. Existing probe validates callback values.
disposition.3_scheduling: Choose largest individual radial contribution versus angular contribution; unresolved support keeps angular priority infinite. No forced completion of every ray before angular decisions.
disposition.4_memory: Comparison rays retain scalar estimates and wall-hit lists only; sample payloads released. Retained fine rays cache5-point sets until upgrade. Memory remains work-bounded, not equal to returned-point count; measurement pending.
disposition.5_vertex_values: Heuristic split direction only, never acceptance/geometry/target. No per-ray tolerance reintroduced.
disposition.6_queues_totals: At least two cuts required before ray queues. Long-double ray/cell totals reduce cancellation; estimates remain nonrigorous. Revision queue matching is unchanged.
